page.overview:
Who is Eliza Masters?

Eliza is portrayed as a beautiful woman with long wavy blonde hair, blue eyes, and an attractive figure.

From what has been shown so far, Eliza seems to be a caring, happy and supportive person. She is shown to have some resentment towards Guile, however, since he has been accidentally hurting her sister emotionally due to Guile's personal grudge towards Shadaloo.

In 1987, Ken begins his search for Ryu, who recently defeated Sagat, six months before. Within Ken's ending in the original Street Fighter Alpha, he wins his match against Ryu and heads back to America, where he meets his future wife Eliza. She makes an impression on him, and not just with her nice looks; as soon as she approaches him, she cheerfully asks him "You fight well, but what are you fighting for? Money, fame, the attention?"; Ken replies that he's fighting to defeat "a certain man", and that he won't stop until he does so, and then a pleased Eliza tells him her name.

Ken qualifies himself into the Second World Fighting Tournament in 1991 (alternatively the Grand Master Challenge Tournament in 1993) after receiving an invitation from Ryu, and leaves Eliza at his beach home before promising to propose to her. When she hears that he has reached quite a high position in the tournament, she flies to Thailand to watch him. At some point she goes to greet him, much to his surprise (featured in Ken's ending); they get married soon afterwards.
